name: hop_v1
input_rule: x[i] = clip((raw[i] / scale[i] - mean[i]) / std[i], -clip, +clip); the network runs once with the pitch plane values (x, vx, tilt toward +x) and once with the yaw plane values (y, vy, tilt toward +y)

inputs.name: height_error
inputs.meaning: mission reference height minus estimated height, m

inputs.name: vertical_speed_error
inputs.meaning: mission reference vertical speed minus estimated vertical speed, m/s

inputs.name: height
inputs.meaning: estimated height of the landing feet above the pad, m

inputs.name: vertical_speed
inputs.meaning: estimated vertical speed, m/s, positive up

inputs.name: lateral_position
inputs.meaning: estimated x (pitch plane run) or y (yaw plane run) from the pad, m

inputs.name: tilt
inputs.meaning: lean of the nose toward +x (pitch run) or +y (yaw run), rad

inputs.name: gimbal
inputs.meaning: this plane's previous gimbal command from the network, rad

inputs.name: throttle
inputs.meaning: throttle command of the previous step, 0 to 1

inputs.name: phase_ascent
inputs.meaning: 1 while climbing to the target height, else 0

inputs.name: phase_hover
inputs.meaning: 1 while holding the target height, else 0

inputs.name: phase_descent
inputs.meaning: 1 during the descent (rocket: unpowered fall; electric vehicle: controlled descent), else 0

inputs.name: phase_landing
inputs.meaning: 1 during the final slow descent to touchdown, else 0

outputs.name: gimbal
outputs.meaning: this plane's gimbal correction added to the PID's = output x 4.0 deg

outputs.name: throttle_vote
outputs.meaning: throttle correction added to the PID's = mean of the two planes' votes x 0.4

evaluation.conditions: 20 flights, seeds 100-119, wind up to 4.0 m/s with 1.5 m/s gusts, hidden errors on
evaluation.table:
